native_findings.finding: Default native read/write timeout3600 seconds; --timeout would set both; unchanged manifest supplies no timeout override.

Server creates SocketStream using read/write durations. Read wait uses select_read and write wait select_write. These bound individual socket readiness waits; they are not an elapsed generation timer.

First result waits through rd.next(connection-close predicate). Queue timeout polls stop state, then continues; subsequent result loop may send SSE ping. Chunk provider waits for next result and only then writes. No3600-second model-computation deadline appears in the inspected path.
Socket liveness is the stop predicate; reader destruction asks cancellation. This does not prove native settlement; exact terminal completion/owner cleanup remains required.

Downstream detach keeps draining exact upstream; nonterminal completion quarantines. Socket closure is not successful GPU settlement.

LAST is bounded by one8h total across64K thennear950K, not8h per rung. Reader receives the same absolute client deadline; reads use remaining budget. A15s count cap and5s full-drain boundary are separate; DONE/usage/full HTTP drain and exact settlement stay required.
